about:
Believes in providing "Get It Right" services to the customers.

Believes in providing "Simple Solution" of the Problem.

Experienced leader with more than 15 years of business development, e-Commerce Website development , team development, process development, sales, marketing, project management, project delivery, and support experience. 

Building a new client base for the leading NetSuite Alliance partner and keeping the existing clients engaged to fuel the growth. 

Leading the team of NetSuite developers and project managers to implement multiple e-Commerce websites for one of the largest Oracle NetSuite customer account. 

Leading the technical and business process development of e-Commerce marketing, merchandising, CRM, third-party integrations, customized business solutions and Supply chain strategies. 

Led global teams for the delivery of multiple successful implementations through onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models.

Business Development Strength:
- Help business to set up Sales and Marketing processes controlling cost of revenue. 
- Successfully close multiple sales deals for the leading technology start-up. 

Team Building and Hiring:
- Successfully build a team of talented developers to deliver value add-in solution in a reasonable timeframe. 
- Successfully demonstrated hiring skills, empowered existing team members and working on team building exercise to build the high performance team. 

Technical Execution Strength:
- Managed technical development to deliver more than 50 solutions for the Oracle NetSuite e-Commerce webstore.
- Brainstormed critical issues to provide resolution for the different business verticals (Marketing, Merchandising, Supply chain, CRM, SRM, Manufacturing department).
